title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Ab-initio Quantum Transport with the GW Approximation, 42, 240 Atoms, and Sustained Exascale Performance
problem: Large-scale quantum transport simulations require verification of correctness and reproducibility of exascale performance claims.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative evaluates computational artifacts for scientific computing papers. The quantum transport paper claims sustained exascale performance on 42,240 atoms.
method: Independent artifact evaluation following SC25 AE guidelines. Verification of quantum transport simulation correctness, reproduction of exascale performance results, assessment of code quality and documentation.
key_novelty: Reproducibility verification of exascale quantum transport simulations using GW approximation.
contributions: Independent evaluation of quantum transport simulation artifact
Assessment of code reproducibility and documentation
workloads: Ab-initio quantum transport with GW approximation
limitations: Reproducibility report only; refer to original paper for technical details.
